change.title: fix(terminal): xterm canvas overflows right-side padding

commits.message:
fix(terminal): move xterm container ref inside padding wrapper

The xterm canvas layers use absolute positioning (position: absolute;
top: 0; left: 0) and fill the element's full clientWidth. When containerRef
was on the padded div (px-4), the canvas overflowed the right-side padding,
causing no padding on the right terminal edge.

Fix: Move containerRef to a new inner div that sits inside the padded outer
div. The inner div's dimensions are naturally reduced by the parent's padding,
so FitAddon.fit() correctly sizes the terminal within the padded content area.
